name: Matjaž Nemec-Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
part_text:
The European Parliament has set out its spending plan for 2026, totalling about 2.64 billion euros, which is 4.09% more than in 2025. Most of the increase pays for salary updates required by law. The plan also asks for more money for cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, energy efficiency and help for trainees with housing costs. It is the Parliament's own proposal; the budget still has to be agreed with the Council, which represents national governments.

- The Parliament proposes to spend 2.64 billion euros in 2026, 4.09% more than in 2025.
- It affects members, staff, assistants, trainees and visitors to the Parliament.
- The Council of national governments must now negotiate and agree the final budget.
